left.raw_text: - Those with a history of allergies including drug allergies (aspirin, antibiotics, etc.), or other clinically significant allergies.
- Those with diseases of the liver (including carriers of hepatitis virus), kidney, respiratory system, endocrine system, nervous system or immune system.

right.raw_text: Those with a medical history of hematology/oncology, psychiatry or cardiovascular diseases.

left.raw_text: - Those with a medical history of gastrointestinal diseases (ulcers, Crohn's disease, etc.)

right.raw_text: or surgery (excluding simple appendectomy or hernia repair), and these situations can affect the absorption of the study drug.
